titel: Life Update: Hawaii, Cabo & Having a Second Baby!

einzeiler: Travel updates on Hawaii and Cabo, plus personal news and a podcast pause.
kurzfassung: Ryan and Amanda share insights and travel highlights from their recent family trips to Maui and Cabo San Lucas. They announce they are expecting their second child, a baby girl due in June. Finally, the hosts reveal they will be taking a temporary break from releasing podcast episodes to focus on their growing family.
stichpunkte: Trip to Maui in January 2024 to visit family and escape the winter.
Complex travel routes required flying from Mexico to Hawaii via mainland US.
Maui highlights included visiting Haleakalā volcano and exploring different coastal areas.
High costs of dining and accommodation in Hawaii noted compared to Mexico.
Trip to Cabo San Lucas and San Jose del Cabo in March 2024 with family.
Comparison of Cabo to California due to westernized vibe and high prices in US dollars.
Personal news: expecting a second baby girl in June 2024.
Announcement of a temporary pause on the podcast to transition into life as a family of four.
beschreibung: This week on the podcast, we’re doing a bit of a life update, sharing about our recent trips to Hawaii and Cabo, as well as giving you some big personal news and show updates. We kick off the episode by talking about our first trip of 2024, which was a family trip to Maui, Hawaii. We talk about what it was like to visit Mauii post-pandemic and after the Lahaina fires, as well as share a little bit about what we did while we were there. We also talk about our trip to Cabo San Lucas, comparing it with other Mexican beach destinations and discussing travel logistics, accommodations, and activities. The episode concludes with some big personal news of expecting a second baby very soon, preparations for welcoming a second baby to the family, and discussing a temporary pause on the podcast to focus on family life. Enjoy!
